info.title: Private Crypto Checkout — public API
info.description: Merchant and hosted-checkout API. Amounts are decimal integer strings.

404.description: no active allowance for this wallet and source asset

parameters.name: session_id
parameters.description: Checkout session id from the payment intent

covers_this_payment.description: Whether it can pay this checkout as currently priced.

api_key.description: Shown once; the previous key no longer authenticates.

remember_device.description: Issue a device token so later checkouts on this browser skip the wallet sign-in.

device_token.description: Present only when `remember_device` was set. Shown once; store it on this device only.

ready.description: True only for a Kernel v3.3 delegation: session grants work as-is.

output_amount.description: Payout-asset base units the merchant receives.

success_url.description: Where to send the payer's browser when they finish. Null when the merchant omitted it.

output_amount.description: Decimal integer string of base units (never a float).

forgotten.description: False when the token was unknown or already expired.

MandateSetupRequest.description: Optional fields default to this checkout's max debit, 12 charges, 24 h apart, 30 days.

code.description: TOTP code; setting up autopay is the payer-present step.

max_amount.description: Per-charge cap in source-token base units.

expires_at.description: The payer must sign before this.

PrepareGrantRequest.description: Every field is optional; defaults are this payment's max debit, 5 uses, 7 days.

max_amount.description: Per-payment cap in token base units. May not be below this payment's max debit.

revoked.description: False when there was no active allowance.

quoted_input.description: Empty when the preview quote failed; authorize then refuses.

expires_at.description: The payer must sign before this.

max_amount.description: Per-payment cap in token base units.

total_exposure.description: Worst case the allowance can move: `max_amount * uses`.

api_key.description: Shown once. Store it in your server's secret manager.

totp_enrolled.description: The wallet already confirmed TOTP in an earlier checkout; skip enrollment.

webhook_secret.description: Shown once; deliveries signed after rotation use this secret.

tags.name: checkout
tags.description: Public hosted checkout; no merchant keys
